On Monday and Wednesday, I plan to focus on mid-game decision-making and objective setups. If you have specific matchups or scenarios you want to review, please send them in advance so that we can prepare efficiently.

On Friday, I would like us to run full scrims and then spend time reviewing key moments from each game. During the review, we should pay attention to communication timing, vision control, and team-fight positioning.

Thank you for your time and effort. Please reply when you have a moment to confirm whether this schedule works for you.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Team / Role]
